view.en: Side-view single-screen 2D room; you control the blue gunner with an arm gun and any weapons won; your health bar and the boss's health bar are at the top of the screen

goal.en: Empty the boss's health bar to win; you lose if your health reaches zero; there is a time limit and a timeout is not a win. Health does not regenerate

keys.en: move left (slow start, slides after release)
move right (slow start, slides after release)
jump; hold to go higher, releasing mid-rise slows it at once

notes.en: Firing counts new presses, so release and press again for each shot; the arm gun allows at most 3 shots on screen, with no charge shot and no slide
Defeating a boss wins its weapon; each shot costs weapon energy, fuse lob and block toss cost more; you cannot switch while a fuse lob or boulder is out
For block toss, stand against a block facing it, press fire to lift and again to throw; only the blade tosser and quake hurler rooms have blocks
After a hit you are knocked back about 0.5 s then flash invulnerable for about 2 s; weapons have strengths and weaknesses against different bosses
One action packet lasts 200 ms and is split into 6 sub-steps

move.en: Horizontal movement; half/4-substep options are short nudges (walking starts slow, then slides after release)

jump.en: Jump timing; holding longer jumps higher, releasing early cuts the rise

options.tap_rehold: tap at sub-step 1, hold again from 3
options.tap_tap6: tap at sub-step 1, press again at 6
options.tap_hold5: tap at sub-step 1, hold again from 5

summary.en: A flat small room; the opponent lobs bombs and leaps in, and each bomb bursts into shards on landing.

tell.en: After landing he holds a bomb up for about 0.25 s and lobs it at you; it lands slightly short of you, 1-3 per round

effect.en: The bomb explodes on landing or on hitting a wall and hurts; shots cannot destroy it

counter.en: Watch the landing spot and jump the shards or back off; he waits for one to burst before throwing the next

tell.en: The bomb bursts into 12 pieces: fast ones up/down/left/right, diagonals and four slow ones

effect.en: Shards hurt on contact

counter.en: Ground-level shards are low, so jumping avoids them; stay away from the landing spot

tell.en: Each round starts with a random jump: a big leap at you or a small hop closer; after a small-hop round he hops away facing back

effect.en: Touching him during a leap hurts

counter.en: A big leap goes over you, so walk under it; he only charges after settling, which is your opening

tell.en: When you get very close he drops the bomb throw and jumps at you

effect.en: It breaks his rhythm but he jumps over you with contact damage

counter.en: Use it to break his throws, but mind where he lands

summary.en: The room has a step and blocks; the opponent throws a returning blade and leaps at close range.

tell.en: He plants his feet and raises the blade for about 0.3 s, then throws it at you; it turns at the room edge and speeds back to his hand

effect.en: The return path also sweeps through your position and hurts

counter.en: While the blade is out he has no weapon, so close in and shoot; do not stand between him and the blade

tell.en: When you are close he jumps; usually over you, sometimes right onto you or in front of you

effect.en: Landing on you does contact damage; he may throw the blade in mid-air

counter.en: When he jumps, walk under him or the other way

tell.en: When you stand on the step and he is on the ground, he runs in place for about 1 s then throws

effect.en: After the wait the blade flies at you

counter.en: The step is a safe place to watch, but dodge once the blade is thrown

tell.en: After being hit he flashes for about 1 second and hops away from you for the first half second

effect.en: Shots pass through him while he flashes; touching him still hurts

counter.en: Do not waste shots while he flashes; wait until he stops

summary.en: The opponent paces, firing at him triggers a counter-pounce, and his main damage is the zigzag arc.

tell.en: He stops and raises a hand for about 0.25 s, then releases a five-part zigzag arc that jumps forward and changes shape every moment

effect.en: The arc deals heavy damage on contact

counter.en: High arcs pass over you when standing; jump low arcs before they arrive, toward him is easier

tell.en: If you fire while he paces, he pounces at once, sometimes as a feint in the other direction

effect.en: Landing on you does contact damage

counter.en: Do not fire while he paces; wait until he stands and discharges

tell.en: If you fire while he is airborne, he charges in the air and releases one arc

effect.en: The arc deals heavy damage and its height follows his

counter.en: Watch the landing and fire less while he is airborne

tell.en: After being hit he flashes for about 1 second and hops away from you for the first half second

effect.en: Shots pass through him while he flashes; touching him still hurts

counter.en: Do not waste shots while he flashes; wait until he stops

summary.en: The opponent keeps a fixed distance, sending ground waves that leave fire pillars.

tell.en: From a distance he gathers fire in his hand for about 0.4 s, then sends it along the ground; up to five per round, about one per second

effect.en: The wave hurts on contact

counter.en: Prepare to jump when the fire gathers and clear the wave near the top of your jump

tell.en: When a wave passes under your feet, a fire pillar rises there for about 2 s

effect.en: The pillar hurts on contact

counter.en: Avoid pillars when landing; the old one dies when he sends the next wave

tell.en: He backs off when you approach and closes in when you retreat; cornered at a wall he turns and walks through you

effect.en: Walking through you does contact damage

counter.en: Shoot while he backs off; beware contact near walls

tell.en: About 0.23 s after being hit he starts a new round of fire

effect.en: He then sends waves

counter.en: Be ready to jump right after landing a hit

tell.en: After five shots he holds a pose and stops; any input from you or leaving the range band restarts him

effect.en: He does not attack while stopped

counter.en: This is a rule quirk; do not rely on it to win

summary.en: The room has a step; the opponent attacks with quaking leaps and thrown boulders.

tell.en: He crouches for about 0.25 s, jumps high, and the screen shakes for about 0.5 s on landing

effect.en: While the screen shakes, you are stunned for about 0.8 s if standing on the ground; contact also hurts

counter.en: Jump just as he lands and stay airborne until the shake ends; he is slow, so you can walk under him

tell.en: He hops once, a boulder drops onto his hands, and after about 0.25 s of holding it he throws it straight at your feet

effect.en: The boulder hurts on contact; shots cannot destroy it

counter.en: He stands still while holding it, so shoot then; jump or move as he throws

tell.en: When the boulder hits a wall, floor or step it breaks into four pieces that keep flying the same way, two angling upward

effect.en: Chunks hurt on contact

counter.en: Chunks appear to the lower right of the impact and fly onward; walk back or jump once the boulder lands

summary.en: The opponent paces between fixed spots and fires piercing darts in a V pattern that speeds up over time.

tell.en: At his spot he charges for about 0.25 s and jumps straight up; he fires one dart at each of three heights on the way down, hangs at the floor, then fires three more going up

effect.en: The darts deal heavy damage on contact

counter.en: Only the ground-level dart needs a jump; the middle and high ones pass over you; do not jump too high into the upper one

tell.en: He walks between four spots; every three landings the darts and hover timing speed up one level, four levels in all

effect.en: He does not attack while walking and has no hit reaction

counter.en: Walking and charging are the safest windows to shoot

phases.en: Every three landings speed up one level, four in total
